snippet.title: Car and Driver gameplay (PC Game, 1992)
snippet.description:
Gameplay for Car and Driver, Dos PC game produced by Electronic Arts in 1992 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/car-and-driver/1324/
Trying out a couple of cars and tracks in this old-school driving sim.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.
